The '''Grievance Striker''' was [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]'s personal [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was later refurbished and used by [[N-K Necrosis]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
[[File:GrievanceStriker-SWE.png|thumb|left|200px|General Grievous's original Grievance Striker]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] wielded a custom [[DT-57 "Annihilator" blaster/Legends|DT-57 "Annihilator" blaster pistol]] known as the Grievance Striker,<ref name="TSoGGLoW" /> in conjunction with the many [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] stolen for his personal collection. Although this served as his secondary weapon after his lightsabers, Grievous was known to use other blasters as well, such as an [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]], which he briefly wielded onboard the [[Malevolence/Legends|Malevolence]] in his first fight against General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and a [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blaster]], which he used to kill [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nahdar Vebb/Legends|Nahdar Vebb]] in [[Grievous's castle/Legends|his lair]] on the [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|third moon of Vassek]].<ref name="TCWts">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref> Like any blaster he used, it could be holstered to the back of his belt or in a holder on his personal [[Tsmeu-6 personal wheel bike]].

[[File:Obiwanshoots.png|thumb|right|200px|Obi-Wan kills Grievous with his own blaster.]]
On [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], Grievous [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|engaged]] Obi-Wan Kenobi in combat again, and with the loss of his lightsabers, attempted to kill the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. However, Obi-Wan disarmed Grievous, and used the General's own blaster against him. Five shots to Grievous's organ sack ignited the oils preserving the remaining organic components of his body, killing him.<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

The blaster was recovered along with Grievous's body by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] following [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], and held in the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] secret storehouse on Utapau. It was later refurbished<ref name="TSoGGLoW" /> by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Treun Lorn]]<ref name="SWG:GS" /> for use of by [[N-K Necrosis]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. A group of spacers later encountered and defeated the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], looting its possessions, including the DT-57.<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>
